row.name: Little Disciples of Jesus Learning Center

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The written feeding instructions for one infant has not been updated within the last 30 days. The form was last completed in May 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant: The play yards were not labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant was observed napping with a blanket in the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The operation does not have a personnel file for a volunteer who is counted in the child/staff ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the seven children's records evaluated the following information was missing:  1. One child lacked a health care statement from a health care professional.  2. Three lacked signed statements from the parent stating the name and address of the health care professional who has examined the child within the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: The caregiver left an infant and toddler who were napping alone in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Of the two personnel records evaluated, one lacked a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An infant was observed napping with a pacifier clip attached to their clothing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the seven children's records evaluated, three were behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Of the seven children's records evaluated, one lacked the required documentation for immunization exemptions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Of the seven children's records evaluated, two lacked the name, address and phone number of the child's physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how parent and emergency contact information, emergency medical information and authorization and sign in/out logs will be evacuated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation (26 TAC §746.5202(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the four children's records evaluated, two lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Disinfecting spray and air freshener were sitting on a shelf accessible to children. Also, cleaning products are being stored in the cabinet underneath the sink are accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The evacuation and relocation diagram does not show the inside relcation area,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the four children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. All lacked a date of admission  2. One lacked the name, address and phone number of the emergency contact.  3. Three lacked the name and telephone number of the persons that can pick up the child.  4. Three lacked the name, address and phone number of the child's doctor.  5. One lacked authorization for emergency medical care.  6. One lacked the name and phone number of the school the child attends.  7. One child's record lacked a shot record or an original exemption from vaccination forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be reunited with their parents once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not state the center's emergency telephone number, how you will communicate with local emergency authorities and Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): The personnel files of both staff lacked a pre-employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was reviewed and it was lacking the following information:  1. Suspension and expulsion policy.  2. Requirements for outdoor/physical activity that includes the benefits, duration a nd type of indoor and outdoor physical activity, recommended clothing and footwear and the criteria used when weather prevents outdoor play.  3. Procedures for parents to participate in the center's activities  4. Instructions on how a parent may access Minimum Standards, contact information for the local Child Care Regulation office and the HHSC website.  5. Staff requirements for annual training in child abuse and neglect; steps to increase and parent awareness regarding abuse and neglect, community organizations that offer assistance, and actions a parent of a child who is a victim of abuse should take to obtain assistance.  6. Staff vaccination policy  7. Steps the center will take to support inclusive services for children with special care needs.  8. Inform parents the center is in a gang free zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection expired on 01/17/2025
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: The CPR certificates were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: The first aid certificates were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: The information for authorization to obtain emergency medical care was not inlcuded on the enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications: The information regarding special needs care was nnot included in the enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications (26 TAC §746.605(13)(B)(i))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The information for the parent rights was not included.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: The two children's file reviewed did not have the health statement on their admissions forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no documentation showing a fire drill had beeen conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There was a caregver that left a 2 year old and 6 year old alone in a room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There was no documentation showing that the smoke detector had been tested,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A monthly active play area chekclist was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: There were no smoke detectors installed at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))
